title: Johnson Arabia — Equipment & Services Knowledge Base
description: Self-contained retrieval chunks for the Johnson Arabia WhatsApp assistant. Covers the mobile crane fleet (detailed spec sheets + fleet catalog), aerial work platforms, used equipment for sale, and service/category guides.
chunking_rule: Each object in `chunks` is one self-contained chunk designed for embedding and retrieval. Equipment chunks carry `model` + `metadata` (taxonomy, manufacturer, capacity, aliases, keywords) + `sections` (Overview first, then titled spec sections). Topic chunks carry `title` + metadata + sections. Match user queries against model names, aliases and keywords; answer from the chunk's sections. Do not merge chunks during indexing — parent category context is already embedded in every chunk.

sections.text: SCX2500 / HSC 250-M ton Hydraulic Crawler Crane & Cable Excavator.

sections.title: Class Rating
sections.text: 250 metric ton.

sections.title: Max Main Boom Length
sections.text: 88.40 m (heavy + light combination); 73.15 m (heavy-duty only).

sections.title: Power Plant
sections.text: Mitsubishi 6D24-TL diesel (optional 6D24-TLU2E EU Stage 2 or 6D24-TLE2A Japanese Stage 2); water-cooled, 4-cycle, direct injection, turbocharged with automatic cooling fan; cylinders 6; bore × stroke 130 mm × 150 mm; rated output 235 kW (320 ps) @ 2,000 rpm; maximum torque 1,245 N·m (127 kgf·m) @ 1,400 rpm; fuel tank 500 liters.

sections.title: Hydraulic System
sections.text: Pump layout: three variable-displacement axial piston pumps + one fixed-displacement duplicate tandem gear pump; reservoir capacity 410 liters; cooling: independent oil cooler with independent autocooling fan (separated from engine radiator); independent circuits: available between P1 main pump / front main drum winch motor and P2 main pump / rear main drum winch motor; control valves: duplicate and triplicate tandem valves actuated by control levers via remote hydraulic servo; SC controller modes: Mode I (engine speed and pump discharge vary simultaneously for precision crane work), Mode II (pump discharge varies while engine speed remains fixed for lifting magnet / bucket work).

sections.title: Load Hoist Assembly (Standard, without Free-Fall)
sections.text: Drive: independent bi-directional variable displacement axial piston motors through 2-stage planetary reducer; brakes: spring-applied, power hydraulically released multiple wet-disc automatic brake within motor; drums: one piece parallel grooved lagging with locking ratchet wheel cast integral; involute-splined to reduction gear shaft; anti-friction bearing mounted; capacity: can wind 51 m of 28 mm diameter cable at drum 1st layer; drum locks: electrically controlled pawl; drum rotation speed control: max rotation tuned electrically by dialing, varying pump discharge; available independently on two main drums; motor swash plate setting: available to synchronize front and rear drum rotation speeds.

sections.title: Load Hoist Assembly (Optional Free-Fall)
sections.text: Brake design: negative brake; multiple wet-disc unit maintaining high safety even if hydraulic pressure drops; installed within drum with reduction gear; no clutch; no brake maintenance required; brake control: dynamic hydraulic pressure with light pedaling force; modes: automatic (for liftcrane) and free-fall (for bucket); free-fall interlocking for fail-safe; cooling: forced-oil cooling on both front and rear drum brake units for continuous heavy-duty operations.

sections.title: Boom Hoist Assembly
sections.text: Design: twin-drum; single bi-directional axial piston hydraulic motor through 3-stage planetary reduction; brake: spring-applied, power hydraulically released multiple wet-disc automatic brake; drum: one piece twin-design parallel grooved lagging; locking ratchet wheel cast integral; bolted to planetary reducer outer case; drum lock: power hydraulically operated automatic pawl; speed control: max rotation tuned electrically by dialing (pump discharge).

sections.title: Luffing Jib Hoist Drum Winch (Optional)

sections.title: Swing System
sections.text: Drive: two bi-directional axial piston motors through 2 sets of planetary reduction powering swing pinion meshing with internal teeth of swing ring gear; brakes: spring-applied, power hydraulically released multiple wet-disc on each motor; max speed control: tuned electrically by dialing and pump discharge; lock: mechanically operated drop pin; speed: 1.5 min⁻¹ (1.5 rpm).

sections.title: Carbody & Crawlers
sections.text: Carbody frame: all-welded precision machined box type with four tip blocks (pins/lugs); machined surface for turntable bearing; hydraulic removal joint-pins: four pins operated by hydraulic cylinders via remote control box to hold crawler side frames; carbody jack-up: four hydraulic jack cylinders on beams for disassembling/assembling crawlers; remote control box; pontoons: four all-welded attached outside carbody weight; crawler side frames: all-welded box type precision machined; steel plate hooks for assembly; held by hydraulic removal heavy-duty joint-pins; carbody weight: 18 t total (9 t front + 9 t rear on jack beams); drive sprockets: cast steel heat treated; one per side; bolt-coupled to 3-stage planetary reduction outer case integral to shoe-in traction motor; floating seal; idler wheels: two bronze bushings with floating seals; lifetime lubrication; track rollers: 13 per side; heat treated cast steel double flange; bronze bushings with floating seals; lifetime lubrication; carrier rollers: 3 per side; heat treated cast steel double flange; bronze bushings; lifetime lubrication; tracks: heat treated self-cleaning multiple hinged; 58 pcs per side; shoe width 1,120 mm standard; track adjustment: manual with oil jack and shim packs (standard); optional automatic track tension via power hydraulic cylinder.

sections.title: Travel & Steering
sections.text: Drive: bi-directional shoe-in axial piston hydraulic motor bolt-coupled to drive sprocket through 3-stage planetary reduction at each crawler end; brake: spring-applied, hydraulically released multiple wet-disc automatic brake within motor; auto-sets when travel levers in neutral or engine shut down; travel speed: 1.1 / 0.5 km/hr (flat, level, firm, no load, 15.25 m basic boom); gradeability: 30% (17°) permissible based on basic machine without front-end attachment.

sections.title: Cab & Operator Station

sections.title: LMI / Safety Systems
sections.text: Type: fully computerized automatic overload preventing system with total safe operation control; design features: no zero-point adjustment; data input via graphic display with interface counter-indication/message; viewing angle adjustable; standard components: load detecting device with amplifier; boom angle detector; computerized MPU; graphic display panel; warning function: 90% rated load = intermittent pre-warning buzzer; 100% rated load = continuous buzzer + automatic stop of all peril-side motions; safety-side motions remain operable; display indicators: lifting load; max allowable lifting load; working radius; max allowable working radius; boom angle; load ratio; boom/jib lengths; engine rpm; overheat warnings: engine over-heat; hydraulic oil over-temperature; brake oil over-temperature; auxiliary safety: hook over-hoist limit switch; boom over-hoist/lowering limiting; boom backstops (dual telescopic spring buffers); dual boom over-hoist limit switch; swing lock (mechanical drop pin, 4 positions); drum locks (pawl on front, rear, boom hoist); free-fall interlock (requires pedal press); swing brake safety circuit; non-drum brake preventing device; boom angle indicator (pendulum); hook latch; level gauge (bubble, cab floor); lever locks; swing alarm (buzzer + flasher lamps); speed slowdown device for boom; swing brake lamp; signal horn; fool-proof shut-off system; travel alarm; engine monitoring lamps; front-end attachment erection mode (internal LMI function); lifting height meter; LMI safety circuit-off switch (key type); rear-view mirrors (2); drum mirror; three-color percentage indicator (Green/Yellow/Red); microphone & loud-speaker optional; drum light optional; aux hook over-hoist limit optional.

sections.title: Front-End Attachments — Crane Boom
sections.text: Lattice construction, round tubular main chords (alloy hi-ten steel), round steel tubing bracing; in-line pin connections at 2.10 m deep × 2.10 m wide; basic boom: two-piece, 15.24 m (7.62 m heavy-duty bottom + tapered top); boom head machinery: five head sheaves + two guide sheaves on anti-friction bearings (conventional non-sealed grease type); optional sheave blocks: six-hanger sheave block (for loads exceeding 145 t, up to 275 t); five-hanger sheave block (for loads exceeding 145 t, up to 250 t); extensions (ultra heavy-duty): optional 3.05 m, 6.10 m, 12.20 m with pendants; heavy-duty extension: optional 12.20 m with pendants; note: no intermediate diagonal bracing except at one picture frame; can nest luffing jib extension into appropriate boom extension; fly jib (optional): lattice, round tubular chords, 1.0 m × 1.0 m pin connections; single sheave head on anti-friction bearings; jib strut, backstops, guyline pendants; mounted on 7.62 m tapered top; fly jib use: light load lifting <25 t with two-part hoist; single part max 13.5 t lift; basic fly jib: two-piece 12.20 m (6.10 m bottom + top); fly jib extensions: 6.10 m with pendants; max fly jib: 36.55 m; auxiliary short jib (optional): all-welded single sheave; pinned to 7.62 m tapered top; boom live mast: 7 m all-welded box; raised by two power hydraulic cylinders; can self-assemble without helper crane using counterweight self-removal device; mid-point suspension link (optional): required when boom exceeds 88.40 m; luffing jib safety additions: luffing jib angle detector; luffing jib load detector; luffing jib over-hoist/lowering limiting; luffing jib hook over-hoist limiting; luffing jib backstops; dual luffing jib over-hoist limit switch; luffing jib hoist drum lock; rear post backstops (two power hydraulic cylinders set by portable power pack).

sections.title: Clamshell Attachment (Optional)
sections.text: Buckets: 1.0 m³, 1.5 m³, 2.0 m³; max clamshell rating 10.0 t (bucket plus load combined); boom range 12 m min; 24 m max; material density earth 1.7–1.8 t/m³; gravel 1.8–2.0 t/m³; counterweight requirement 37.1 t arrangement (deduct block C or D from 46 t full set), plus 9.5 t carbody and 1.7 t aux; max digging depth 36 m.

sections.text: Capacities are maximum allowable on firm level surface under ideal conditions; based on ≤ 78% of minimum tipping load (bold-line values = structural strength limitation instead); 360° rated; least stable condition is over the side; required dead weight for all capacities: 86.3 t upper counterweight + 1.7 t auxiliary weight + 14.0 t carbody weight; deductions required for hook block, slings, and suspended gear; main boom must not exceed 88.40 m; attachment must be erected and lowered over the ends of the crawler mounting.

ALL TERRAIN HYDRAULIC MOBILE

sections.text:
ARTICULATED ALL TERRAIN HYDRAULIC MOBILE
These cranes contain a boom that has a series of folding, pin connected structural members, typically manipulated to extend or retract.

sections.title: Truck Mounted Hydraulic Mobile Cranes — Guide
sections.text:
TRUCK MOUNTED HYDRAULIC MOBILE
This is a self-propelled loading-unloading crane, mounted on a truck body, with a working section consisting of a rotating cantilevered boom.

sections.title: Rough Terrain (4x4) Hydraulic Mobile Cranes — Guide
sections.text:
ROUGH TERRAIN (4X4) HYDRAULIC MOBILE
These are compact cranes with a single cab for both driving and lifting operation with maneuverability and can be driven on rough or uneven terrain.

sections.title: Telescopic Boom Crawler Cranes — Guide
sections.text:
TELESCOPIC BOOM CRAWLER
Designed for quick and safer set up without the need of setting up the outriggers and mats, these cranes offer lesser transportation costs. This is intended on a fast moving projects with tight deadlines.

chunks.title: Lattice Boom Hydraulic Crawler Cranes — Guide

sections.title: Lattice Boom Hydraulic Crawler Cranes — Guide
sections.text:
LATTICE BOOM HYDRAULIC CRAWLER
These are heavy-duty machines and can be easily used for various applications and industries that require the lifting of heavy items or materials. They are very useful in construction project sites.

sections.title: Self-Erecting Mounted Tower Cranes — Guide
sections.text:
SELF-ERECTING MOUNTED TOWER
These cranes can satisfy the most demanding requirements thanks to their rapid erection and easy operation. They are versatile and easy to operate. They are very useful in construction project sites.

sections.title: Spider Cranes — Guide
sections.text:
SPIDER CRANE
Light and compact body. The pick & carry feature makes these cranes are logical choice for customers which cover a wide range of applications, from construction work to natural resource development.

sections.title: Diesel 4x4 Articulated Boom Lifts — Guide
sections.text:
DIESEL 4X4 ARTICULATED BOOM LIFTS
With multiple boom sections that hinge, this is suitable for sites where an operator has to reach and work over obstacles. This machine is ideal for construction sites.

sections.title: Diesel 4x4 Telescopic Boom Lifts — Guide
sections.text:
DIESEL 4X4 TELESCOPIC BOOM LIFTS
With an extended horizontal and vertical outreach, 4X4 Telescopic Boom Lifts are suitable to carry out work in congested sites. This is machine is ideal for construction project sites.

sections.title: Electric Boom Lifts — Guide
sections.text:
ELECTRIC BOOM LIFTS
Run on rechargeable batteries, these boom lifts offer an environmental friendly solutions on sites. Compact and limited, suitable for limited spaces or restrictions on weight. This is ideal for construction project sites.

sections.title: Diesel 4x4 Scissor Lifts — Guide
sections.text:
DIESEL 4X4 SCISSOR LIFTS
With competitive lift speed, higher safe working load and large platforms, these help increase productivity on vertical jobs at challenging job sites. This is ideal for construction project sites.

sections.title: Electric Scissor Lifts — Guide
sections.text:
ELECTRIC SCISSOR LIFTS
Run on rechargeable batteries, these offer an environmental friendly solution on a site.They elevate vertically and are compact and useful on finished job sites.

sections.title: Crawler Boom Lifts — Guide
sections.text:
CRAWLER BOOM LIFTS
Crawlers are able to reach more places on a site due to its low weight, compact size and non-marking rubber tracks. These are very popular in shopping malls.

sections.title: Push Around Lifts — Guide
sections.text:
PUSH AROUND LIFTS
These lifts elevate vertically using rechargeable batteries and stabilize with the help of outriggers. These lifts are pushed from one work area to another.
